name: Raw Forest Honey
story: Gathered from wild Apis dorsata combs in the mangrove forest, strained once and never heated. It carries the flower of its month — so a winter jar and a spring jar are not the same honey.
note: Crystallises in winter. This is a sign of life, not fault.

maker.name: The Sundarban mouli cooperative
maker.blurb: Honey-hunters who enter the forest by boat and read the bees the old way. Ghritam buys the whole season at a fair, fixed price so a thin month does not become a hungry one.
